doc.name: amigurumi.ai
doc.instructions: amigurumi.ai has free crochet toy patterns, each with a 3D model and exact rounds. Use search_toys to find toys (then get_toy for one), and circle_calculator for custom circles, balls and tubes. Link to the pattern pages; do not copy whole patterns.

tools.name: search_toys
tools.title: Find amigurumi patterns
tools.description: Search the free amigurumi (crochet toy) patterns on amigurumi.ai. Every pattern has a 3D model and exact round-by-round instructions. Use it when the user wants a crochet toy, plushie or amigurumi pattern or idea, optionally by size, difficulty, no-sew construction, category or yarn colour. Shows the toys as cards.

query.description: Words to match: an animal, character, food or colour ("frog", "pink bunny", "dragon"). Leave out to browse.

size.description: Finished height: small < 10 cm, medium 10–20 cm, large > 20 cm.

maxHeightCm.description: Only toys at most this tall, in cm.

maxDifficulty.description: 1 = beginner, 2 = easy, 3 = intermediate. Use 1 for "for beginners".

noSew.description: Only no-sew toys: ears, limbs and tails are crocheted into the body, nothing to sew on.

colours.description: Yarn colours the toy must have.

time.description: How long it takes: evening ≤ 4 h, weekend ≤ 9 h, week longer.

lang.description: The language of the user's conversation: 'ru' for Russian, else 'en'.

tools.name: get_toy
tools.title: Show a toy pattern
tools.description: Show one amigurumi pattern from amigurumi.ai: picture, size, difficulty, hook, yarn weight and colours with metres, and links to the full pattern and crochet mode. Use after search_toys when the user picks a toy or asks what it needs.

lang.description: The language of the user's conversation: 'ru' for Russian, else 'en'.

tools.name: circle_calculator
tools.title: Amigurumi shape calculator
tools.description: Work out the rounds for an amigurumi circle, ball or tube of a given size: sc in a spiral from a magic ring, staggered increases and decreases, stitch counts, size and yarn. Use when the user asks how many rounds or stitches they need for a size, or wants a basic shape for their own toy.

shape.description: circle = flat disc (ears, bases, eyes); ball = stuffed sphere (heads, bodies); tube = closed end and straight sides (arms, legs, bodies).

lengthCm.description: Tube only: length from the closed end, in cm.

stitchesPer10cm.description: The user's measured gauge: sc per 10 cm (needs roundsPer10cm).

roundsPer10cm.description: The user's measured gauge: rounds per 10 cm.

lang.description: The language of the user's conversation: 'ru' for Russian, else 'en'.
